title: Easy Edits style pack
description: One JSON file = one editing style: palette, fonts, caption look, motion, pacing and the scenes it allows. Validated by easy-edits/engine/style-pack.mjs (`easy-edits style validate <pack>`); the renderer refuses a pack that fails this schema and any request (mode, format, plan beat, flag) the pack does not allow.

id.x-error: must be 2-32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter
id.description: Short id, lowercase letters, digits and dashes: what `--style <id>` takes.

description.description: One or two sentences: what the style looks and feels like.

useFor.description: What kind of video this style suits (goes into the generated skill).

modes.description: Modes that may render with this pack. clean-cut is not listed: it keeps the approved caption look.

surface.description: Top-box panels (a gradient from surface to background).

accent.description: The signature colour: bars, discs, highlights.

accent2.description: Second colour (the left side of a compare, glitch split).

onAccent.description: Text and icons drawn on an accent fill.

font.description: Which of the pack's fonts the captions use.

size.description: Caption size in px on 9:16 (1080 wide); 1:1 and 16:9 scale it like the house captions.

maxChars.description: Characters per caption group (one or two lines).

color.description: "auto" samples the footage behind each caption and picks light or dark text; a #RRGGBB fixes it.

highlight.description: keywords: numbers and the plan's key words; active-word: the word being spoken.

animation.description: pop: scale overshoot; fade-up: rise and fade in; type: words appear as they are spoken.

edge.description: Outline width in px (painted under the fill; its colour follows the text colour).

transition.description: What happens at every layout change: hard cut, a whip-pan smear, a dip through the background colour, or an RGB-split glitch.

entrance.description: How panels, pops and the hook come in.

numbers.description: Stat values: slam in big, count up from zero, or decode through random digits.

signature.description: The style's signature move on every punch-in: a zoom hit with a short shake, cinematic letterbox bars, or HUD corner brackets around the face.

drift.description: Slow push-in over a face segment (0.035 = 3.5%).

minBeatGap.description: Seconds between two pops / punch-ins (top boxes are spaced by the planner).

scenes.description: Every scene the style may show. Anything else is refused (a --plan beat, --hook, --speaker) or left out (planner beats, intro / outro, progress bar).

music.description: Default Openverse search for the music bed (talking-head / explainer), null = no music. --music / --no-music override it.
